holderQuote: And Hethon saw his younger brother, riding behind Jericha, Tyrion’s [Aide], [Mage], and retainer.

Tyrion looked mystified. Shamefaced, his [Mage]-[Aide] bowed towards Tyrion. She was high-level, competent, as close to a babysitter as Ullim to Hethon. More than once Jericha had minded him. Hethon liked Jericha. So did Sammial—mostly. He usually suffered Jericha more than Ullim.
All women. Including Zenna. The half-Elf was old, old enough to have grey hair mixed with auburn.
the [Aide] hesitated. And then reached out to touch Ryoka’s shoulder.
The [Aide] dipped her head, but she looked back at Ryoka.
Briganda snapped at Jericha. The [Aide] hesitated.
She looked at Tyrion. The [Lord] glanced at Jericha. The [Aide] sighed.

He nearly ran off, but his older brother had a grip on his arm. He had to; they’d already lost poor Jericha. The [Aide] might be a trained warrior and so on, but she was no match for running children on a sugar and excitement-high, racing through the crowd and squeezing through gaps she could never manage.
She was straightening when she saw Jericha’s wrathful face. The woman was standing right behind her.
Jericha nodded, hovering and fulfilling the role of [Aide] and [Strategist] at the same time.
